At Camellia Artisanal, all our Sondesh are handcrafted without artificial chemical sweeteners or corn syrups: 🌸

• *Authentic Nolen Gur Norom Pak*: Made with 100% natural, unrefined date palm jaggery (Nolen Gur). It has a lower glycemic index and a mild, natural sweetness compared to refined white sugar sweets.
• *Mild Sweetness Profile*: Because we make fresh small batches with pure dairy / A2 cow milk chhena, our Sondesh is noticeably light and subtly sweetened, never cloying.
• *Diabetic Guidance*: While naturally sweetened with pure Nolen Gur or minimal unrefined cane sugar, it is not certified medical zero-calorie sugar-free. We recommend moderation or consulting with a physician for strict diabetic diets.
